_comment: Scene 10 (push the button). The articulated e-stop (estop_button.usda): a PhysicsArticulationRoot with a world-fixed base + a prismatic 'press_joint' (cap slides down along the button axis). kind:articulation spawns it as an ArticulationCfg so the joint stays live. USDA is metersPerUnit=0.01, upAxis=Y, ~300 units tall -> scale 3.71e-4 (=>~0.12m) + rot 90deg about X (Y-up->Z-up, so the press axis points down into the table). fix_base anchors it. press_joint: authored travel ~8 stage-units => ~3mm after scale; the actuator gives it a spring return the robot must overcome. Verify z (base resting on table) + press stroke in the smoke render.
